# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_REAL_FILLS_GRINDER_KEEPER_1

**Filed:** 2026-07-21

**Type:** quality_gate

## Hypothesis

The hypothesis is that increasing entry quality filters (higher volume multiplier, minimum candlestick body, and requiring multiple confirming signals) will reduce low-quality entries and improve win rate. Combined with tighter exit parameters (10% premium stop, 50% TP1 at 50% position, and profit-lock settings), this aims to limit losses on losing days while capturing gains on winning days. The specific parameter changes target better trade selection and risk management to improve edge capture on J's anchor days.

## Mechanism

**Entry triggers:** Requires volume ≥1.1× 20-bar average (`vol_mult=1.1`), minimum candlestick body ≥$0.02 (`body_min_cents=0.02`), at least 2 confirming signals (`min_stars=2`), strike selection 2 strikes OTM (`strike_offset=2`), price within $1.50 of a level (`proximity_dollars=1.5`), and break must be above the open price (`require_break_above_open=true`).  
**Exit logic:** Premium stop-loss at -10% (`premium_stop_pct=-0.1`), first TP1 at +50% premium (`tp1_premium_pct=0.5`) selling 50% of position (`tp1_qty_fraction=0.5`), runner target at +200% (`runner_target_pct=2.0`), profit-lock arms at +5% (`profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05`) and trails stop to entry +5% (`profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05`).  
**Position sizing:** Fixed quantity of 10 contracts (`qty=10`).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=10 requires $10K-$25K account per position sizing schedule; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Grinder selected 5 keepers from an initial combination set; selection method based on undisclosed filters carries overfit risk from optimizing noise.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no validation of top 3 J days against realistic OPRA fills).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day observed -$382.0 (2025-02-12); max drawdown unknown without equity curve; blow-up scenario involves consecutive losses exceeding 50% daily risk limit given fixed qty=10.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires full backtest to compute top5_pct; visible by_day shows large positive day ($694.2 on 2025-01-10) but total P&L unavailable.
